columns.comment: Calendar date of the trading day. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the trading day as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the trading day, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the trading day).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: The group's lead (relationship) legal entity, e.g. the entity holding the account plan.
columns.name: Lead Client

columns.comment: Group segment (most common segment of its APAC clients): Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Group relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic groups" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for groups headquartered in Japan (Japanese corporate groups) - "Japanese corporates" / "JC" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Group industry sector (most common sector of its APAC clients), e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Group industry subsector (most common subsector of its APAC clients), e.g. Automotive Parts, Shipping.
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Lead office of the group = coverage office of its lead entity, ISO-2 code (SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand).
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Group lead RM = current primary RM of the group's lead entity (fictional name).
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the group lead RM sits - "RMs in Singapore" means this.
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Worst (highest) internal rating grade 1-10 among the group's rated APAC clients today; null = no rated client.
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: Highest IFRS 9 stage (1-3) among the group's APAC clients today.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when at least one APAC client of the group is on the credit watchlist today.
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating (Low, Medium, High) of the group's lead entity today; null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Worst current early-warning band among the group's APAC clients (Red > Amber > Green); null = none scored.
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Listed parent company of the client group (fictional, e.g. Hagiwara Steel KK) - one per group.
columns.name: Listed Parent

columns.comment: Agency rating of the listed parent in force on the trading day (primary agency first; fictional agencies; AAA ... D scale).
columns.name: External Rating

columns.comment: Outlook attached to the rating in force: Stable, Positive or Negative.
columns.name: Outlook

columns.comment: True when the parent closed at (or below) its 52-week low that trading day.
columns.name: At 52-Week Low

columns.comment: True when the group's APAC credit exposure is above USD 100m (gold.dim_threshold MARKET_APAC_EXPOSURE_USD).
columns.name: APAC Exposure Above 100m

columns.comment: Listed parents with a close on the last trading day of the selection (point-in-time).
columns.name: Listed Parents

columns.comment: Average 1-day share-price return of the parents on the last trading day of the selection (fraction).
columns.name: Average Share Price Change 1D %

columns.comment: Average share-price change vs 30 calendar days earlier of the parents on the last trading day of the selection (fraction; -0.20 = -20%).
columns.name: Average Share Price Change 30D %

columns.comment: Average CDS-like credit spread of the parents on the last trading day of the selection, in basis points.
columns.name: Average CDS Spread bps

columns.comment: Average change of the CDS spread over the last 30 days, bps, on the last trading day of the selection (positive = widening = worse).
columns.name: Average CDS Change 30D bps

columns.comment: Client groups whose listed parent closed at its 52-week low on the last trading day of the selection.
columns.name: Groups at 52-Week Low

columns.comment: APAC credit exposure of the groups (drawn lending + trade finance outstanding at the latest month-end) on the last trading day of the selection, USD - point-in-time.
columns.name: APAC Exposure USD

columns.comment: APAC exposure of the groups whose parent is at its 52-week low, on the last trading day of the selection (USD).
columns.name: APAC Exposure at 52-Week Low USD

columns.comment: Market capitalisation of the listed parents on the last trading day of the selection, USD.
columns.name: Market Cap USD

columns.comment: Agency downgrades of the listed parents (any agency) over the selected days - a flow.
columns.name: Rating Downgrades

columns.comment: Agency upgrades of the listed parents over the selected days - a flow.
columns.name: Rating Upgrades

columns.comment: Agency outlook revisions to Negative over the selected days - a flow.
columns.name: Outlook Changes to Negative

columns.comment: First days at a 52-week low after 30 days without one (the MARKET_52W_LOW signals) over the selected days.
columns.name: 52-Week Low Events

comment: Market signals on the listed parents of APAC client groups (220 listed parents, trading days Apr-2025 to Sep-2026, fictional market-data vendor): share-price change 1D / 30D, CDS-like spread and its 30-day change, parents at their 52-week low, the agency rating and outlook in force, agency downgrades / upgrades / negative outlook changes, and the group's APAC credit exposure (drawn lending + trade finance outstanding, USD). Prices, spreads, counts of parents and exposure are POINT-IN-TIME: they return the last trading day of the selection (filter Date = DATE'2026-09-30' for today); rating actions and 52-week-low events add up. Grain: one row per listed parent per trading day (gold.fact_market_signal_daily).
